audit.whatIsWrong: Five strings tell you to play around Gragas's 'Q pool sustain'. Barrel Roll is a thrown cask and it heals him for nothing; the sustain is the passive.
audit.why: Riot's Barrel Roll text: he 'rolls his cask to a location, which can be activated to explode or will explode on its own after 4 seconds. The potency of the explosion increases over time' — damage and a slow, no heal. Riot's Happy Hour: 'Gragas periodically heals upon using a skill.' So his sustain is tied to casting anything at all, not to a pool you can zone him off, which changes the answer from 'deny the Q' to 'kill him inside the window rather than chip him'.
audit.corrected: Happy Hour heals him periodically on every skill cast — chip poke does not stick, so trade in bursts that finish.

audit.whatIsWrong: wants.you[1] and early both tell you to hold Aegis Assault to block the Body Slam 'line'. Body Slam stuns, and a stun ends the channel.
audit.why: Riot's Body Slam text: he 'charges to a location and collides with the first enemy unit he comes across, dealing damage to all nearby enemy units and stunning them' — 14/13.5/13/12.5/12. Aegis Assault is a channel the kit flags as cancelled by any CC, so channelling into his engage spends 22 seconds to eat a stun anyway. _missing-interactions.json flags the same channel break.
audit.corrected: Never channel Aegis Assault into Body Slam. Bait its 14s instead, then W-stun into the empowered Q.

audit.whatIsWrong: No cooldowns anywhere, and the coverage packet records that not one Gragas ability is named in the content layer.
audit.why: Body Slam 14s at rank 1 at 600 range — the same reach as Shield Vault and one second longer on cooldown, which is the entire trading rhythm. Barrel Roll 10s at 850, Drunken Rage 5s, Explosive Cask 100s at 1000.
audit.corrected: All five named with the numbers; Body Slam's 14s against Shield Vault's 13s stated as the window.

edits.before: Gragas is squishy and immobile pre-6, so the first three levels are yours. At level 1 your W stun damage is point-and-click — there's no dodging it — and at 2 your W+Q burst hurts him before his Q pool sustain can heal it back. Hold E to eat his body-slam (E) and a Q poke, then commit. Don't dump everything into his W damage-reduction window; bait it, then W-stun and empowered-Q him.
edits.after: Gragas is squishy pre-6, so the first three levels are yours. Shield Vault leaps 600 with a stun he cannot dodge, and at 2 the W+Q burst lands before Happy Hour can heal it back — it ticks on every skill he casts, so chip alone gets you nothing. Never channel Aegis Assault into Body Slam: its stun cancels the channel. Bait that 14s, and bait Drunken Rage's damage cut on 5s, then commit.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay roughly even — your empowered-Q poke and E blocks keep pressure, but his Q pool out-sustains your chip and he stabilizes. The real swing is 6: Grand Starfall is built for roams, not this 1v1, while his R knockback flips your all-in entirely — he can body-slam in, ult you off your wave or under his tower, and W-reduce your burst. Use your R to roam and snowball other lanes rather than forcing a duel he now wins.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay roughly even — empowered-Q keeps pressure, but Happy Hour heals him on every cast so chip never accumulates. Body Slam reaches 600, the same as Shield Vault, on 14s against your 13s: that one second is your whole window. The swing is 6, where Explosive Cask on 100s knocks you off your wave or under his tower. Roam with Grand Starfall rather than force a duel he now wins.

notes: The repeated 'Q pool sustain' was a fabricated mechanic — Barrel Roll is a thrown cask with damage and a slow, and nothing in Gragas's kit is a pool. His sustain is Happy Hour, which heals periodically on ANY skill cast, so the counterplay is the opposite of what the page implied: you cannot deny it by zoning a location, you beat it by trading in bursts that finish rather than chipping. Second correction: the page told you to hold Aegis Assault for Body Slam, but Body Slam stuns, and a stun cancels the channel — you would spend 22 seconds to eat the engage anyway. Body Slam's 600 range exactly matches Shield Vault's, on 14s against your 13s, which is the trading rhythm the page never stated.
